messages:
lauren: heads-up - a customer hit a runtime error when using the JS SDK inside Cloudflare Workers: "ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined" and then a cascade when auth tried to use node:crypto.
samir: yep, that happens when the bundler resolves the cjs build or when types reference Buffer in d.ts. Workers don't have Buffer or node: modules.
yuki: quick triage: are they importing the package normally or doing a default import that triggers CJS interop? some bundlers fall back to cjs because of package.json fields order.
lauren: they did `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` with an old rollup config. changing to `import {createClient} from 'redwood-sdk/edge'` fixed it locally, but we shouldn't make customers guess that.
samir: agreed. proposal: publish an explicit dist/edge/entry with zero node deps (no Buffer, no node:crypto, no fs, no net). add "edge" conditional export and a short import path we recommend in docs. also update README quickstarts and the CF Workers sample app.
yuki: for auth, use WebCrypto HMAC. example shim I prefer (async function returning hex):
```
export async function hmacHex(key, msg) {
  const k = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(key), {name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256'}, false, ['sign']);
  const sig = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', k, new TextEncoder().encode(msg));
  return [...new Uint8Array(sig)].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}
```
lauren: can we ship that in the SDK edge build so users don't need to shim?
samir: yes. also: normalize streaming outputs to Web ReadableStream in edge build. many of our internal helpers return Node Readables which break in Workers. add a tiny adapter util in dist/edge that converts Node streams to Web Streams when possible or always produce Web Streams.
yuki: retries/backoff: avoid timers that rely on Node's `setTimeout` semantics. Workers do have setTimeout but long sleeps are unreliable. use short backoffs and AbortController-driven timeouts on fetch. example pattern: attempt fetch with AbortController and a small delay loop for backoff.
lauren: typing issues: our d.ts mentions Buffer in a few places. I propose creating an "edge" types file that replaces Buffer with Uint8Array and exports a compatibility alias: `type EdgeBuffer = Uint8Array;`. then map typesVersions in package.json so TS resolves the right types for modern tsconfig paths.
samir: packaging considerations: some bundlers ignore nonstandard export keys. include an explicit `/edge` subpath export too: e.g., "./edge": { "import": "./dist/edge/index.mjs" } so consumers can always import 'redwood-sdk/edge'.
yuki: CI: add a smoke test that runs the edge entry in Miniflare (headless) and runs a tiny auth handshake + embedding call to validate runtime-only dependencies. infra-bot can queue it when PRs touch src/auth or package.json exports.
infra-bot: Task created: `devex/edge-smoke-miniflare` by lauren - will run on PRs affecting exports or auth.
lauren: UX suggestion: update the onboarding sample app templates for Workers and Vercel edge with explicit notes and one-click deploys. docs should have a troubleshooting section: list of common missing Node APIs and recommended fixes (edge bundle import, small shim snippets, how to polyfill during local dev).
samir: last thing: add a runtime guard in the common auth module that throws a clear error if node:crypto or Buffer is referenced and suggests the edge import path and the yarn/npm resolution snippet. that's less cryptic than the current stack traces.
yuki: i'll start a PR that adds dist/edge build, exports mapping, types edge mapping, and the miniflare smoke test. lauren: thanks — i'll validate with the customer and post the sample-config we used. :sparkles:
